Q_EMPTY_BEFORE.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM sqlite_master WHERE name NOT LIKE 'sqlite_%' AND name NOT LIKE '_cf_%'

Q_SCHEMA_COUNTS.sql: SELECT type, COUNT(*) AS n FROM sqlite_master WHERE name NOT LIKE 'sqlite_%' AND name NOT LIKE '_cf_%' AND name <> 'd1_migrations' GROUP BY type ORDER BY type

Q_MIGRATION_LEDGER.sql: SELECT name FROM d1_migrations ORDER BY id

Q_CONTENT_TABLES_ABSENT.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM sqlite_master WHERE name IN ('source_items','approved_briefs','source_feeds','handoff_log')

Q_STATS_OBJECTS_ABSENT_IN_CONTENT_DB.phase: before and after every statistics step
Q_STATS_OBJECTS_ABSENT_IN_CONTENT_DB.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM sqlite_master WHERE name LIKE 'statistics_%' OR name LIKE 'trg_stat_%' OR name LIKE 'idx_stat_%' OR name LIKE 'uq_stat_%' OR name LIKE 'v_stat_%'

Q_SOURCES.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM statistics_sources

Q_POLICY_ROWS.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM statistics_source_runtime_policy

Q_NOT_DISABLED.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM statistics_source_runtime_policy WHERE runtime_state IN ('ACTIVE','ACTIVATION_GATED','PAUSED')

Q_ALL_SOURCES_DEFAULT_DISABLED.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM statistics_sources s WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM statistics_source_runtime_policy p WHERE p.source_id = s.source_id)

Q_NO_RUNS_NO_DATA.phase: after registry bootstrap and after binding deploy
Q_NO_RUNS_NO_DATA.sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM statistics_ingestion_runs) AS runs, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM statistics_observation_versions) AS versions, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM statistics_current_observations) AS current_rows, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM statistics_releases) AS releases

fingerprint.query: SELECT type, name, sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE name NOT LIKE 'sqlite_%' AND name NOT LIKE '_cf_%' AND name <> 'd1_migrations' ORDER BY type, name

steps.purpose: read-only preflight: account, existing databases, content DB baseline
steps.command: npx wrangler whoami; npx wrangler d1 list --json; npx wrangler d1 execute global-content-os --remote --json --command "SELECT type, name, sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE name NOT LIKE 'sqlite_%' AND name NOT LIKE '_cf_%' AND name <> 'd1_migrations' ORDER BY type, name" | node scripts/statistics-schema-fingerprint.mjs
steps.expected_output: the expected account; exactly the known databases and NO database named global-content-os-stats; the content DB fingerprint is recorded as the BEFORE baseline
steps.hard_stop: a database named global-content-os-stats already exists, or the account is not the expected one, or the content DB already contains statistics objects

steps.command: npx wrangler d1 create global-content-os-stats   (no --location: automatic placement; the owner may add one explicit location hint, it does not change the contract)
steps.expected_output: prints a new database_id (a UUID that differs from the content database id c0ce92dc-9842-4dd9-9d05-a8d09e798b34); the database is empty; it is created in the same account as the Worker
steps.rollback: leave it UNBOUND and EMPTY (nothing references it). Deleting it needs a separate explicit approval OWNER_APPROVAL_DELETE_EMPTY_STATS_DB; it is never deleted automatically
steps.hard_stop: the command fails, prints an id equal to any existing database id, or prints no id: stop, do not retry blindly, inspect with wrangler d1 list

steps.purpose: write the local stats-only migration config (never committed) and record the Time Travel baseline

steps.expected_output: the config names ONLY STATS_DB with migrations_dir migrations/statistics; no content database entry; the real id exists only in the git-ignored copy
steps.hard_stop: the config contains the content database id or any DB binding other than STATS_DB

steps.purpose: apply statistics migration 0001 to the new STATS_DB only

steps.purpose: post-migration verification: schema fingerprint equals the frozen one and the content database is unchanged
steps.command: npx wrangler d1 execute STATS_DB --remote --config release/wrangler.stats-migrate.toml --json --command "<FINGERPRINT_QUERY>" | node scripts/statistics-schema-fingerprint.mjs ; the same fingerprint script against the content DB (as in I0)
steps.expected_output: STATS_DB fingerprint sha256 3497b347f506ba0db08c2bd43ffa2181e2d41563a42ad559666c3f48f6d2ffe4 with counts {index 27, table 18, trigger 49, view 1}; the content DB fingerprint equals the I0 baseline; no statistics object in the content DB
steps.hard_stop: any mismatch of fingerprint, counts or ledger, or any statistics object in the content database

steps.purpose: registry bootstrap: 32 source IDENTITY rows, no policy rows, all DISABLED
steps.command: npx wrangler d1 execute STATS_DB --remote --config release/wrangler.stats-migrate.toml --file release/statistics-registry-bootstrap.sql   (generated; check with node scripts/statistics-build-bootstrap-sql.mjs --check)
steps.expected_output: 32 inserts; idempotent (INSERT OR IGNORE); no ACTIVE or ACTIVATION_GATED value anywhere in the file
steps.rollback: identity rows are retire-only (no delete); nothing is active, so nothing needs undoing
steps.hard_stop: any count other than 32 sources / 0 policy rows, or any error

steps.purpose: verify the source default is DISABLED everywhere and nothing has run
steps.command: npx wrangler d1 execute STATS_DB --remote --config release/wrangler.stats-migrate.toml --json --command "<Q_ALL_SOURCES_DEFAULT_DISABLED; Q_NOT_DISABLED; Q_NO_RUNS_NO_DATA>"
steps.expected_output: every source has no policy row (DISABLED by the frozen default); 0 ACTIVE/ACTIVATION_GATED/PAUSED; 0 runs, 0 versions, 0 current rows, 0 releases
steps.hard_stop: any source not DISABLED or any run/data row present
